summary.headline: Pythagorean and Astrological Notes
summary.text: Catalog of notes in a Neapolitan astrological codex, including Pythagorean writings, Chaldean philosophy, the seven planets, numerical figures, zodiacal signs and lunar conditions, physical lore, magic formulas, and astrological figures. Cross-references cite the Mutin, Bonon, and Matrit codices; a final note identifies John the notary.
